notes: The printed 21 and 19 AADs are episode counts, not a binary count of participants with at least one episode. The placebo episode count 19 differs from served ci=17. Table 4, ITT population, prints S boulardii: 21 (8.5%) participants with 1 episode and 0 with 2; placebo: 15 (6.5%) with 1 episode and 2 (0.9%) with 2. The served placebo participant count requires adding these categories and is not extracted because arithmetic is prohibited. The experimental percentage is the printed one-episode percentage; no combined placebo percentage is printed. Denominators match the served totals and represent all randomized participants included in ITT. PP columns report the same two randomized arms, with n = 146 each, not additional arms. The main outcome uses the modified WHO definition (at least 2 days); AAD onset was not before the third day of antibiotic treatment.
